# appdynamics_health_rules (Data Source)

Lists the health rules defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_health_rules" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "health_rule_names" {
  value = [for hr in data.appdynamics_health_rules.all.health_rules : hr.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list health rules for.

### Read-Only

- `health_rules` (Attributes List) The health rules defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--health_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_rules`

Read-Only:

- `affected_entity_type` (String) The entity type this health rule evaluates, e.g. TIER_NODE_HARDWARE, BACKENDS, BUSINESS_TRANSACTION_PERFORMANCE.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Health rule ID.
- `name` (String)
